cruden number search (/home/claude/baldus-scr/rev/y20-B/cruden-EO_14177.json): only copies of EO 14177 and EO 14354
reasoning: Hashes, quotes and the 25-clause inventory match the held text (90 FR 8643). The operative clauses are well supported: the 42 U.S.C. 6601 note prints the order without annotation, EO 14354 (effective 2025-09-30) continues PCAST to 2027-09-30, the section 5 two-year term runs past the cutoff, and the OFR notes (Revokes EO 14007; Continued by EO 14354; See EO 12968 and the misdated EO 14009 entry) are all addressed. But the section 6 first_end date is 2022-01-23, three years before the order was signed and contrary to the judgment_reason and rationale (January 23, 2025).
